# docsrs-cli
> One-shot stdin/stdout CLI for crates.io and docs.rs documentation for LLM agents.

docsrs-cli is a born-execute-finalize-die binary that searches crates on crates.io, fetches docs.rs README overviews and typed rustdoc items, searches in-crate symbol indexes, and validates local readiness with doctor. Stdout is the data contract. Stderr is diagnostics only. JSON is automatic when stdout is not a TTY. Current release is 1.3.0.

## Release 1.3.0 agent surface
- `data.anchor_family` on get-item reports the rustdoc anchor family the markdown was scoped to (`method`, `tymethod`, `associatedtype`, `associatedconstant`, `variant`, `structfield`)
- `data.extraction` still reads `method` for every family: it means "scoped to the member anchor", never "the member is a function". Read `anchor_family` for the family and keep asserting `extraction` to reject a parent-page false success
- `error.suggestions` is an array of `{path, kind}` on a not-found whose `--suggest` ladder found candidates; omitted when it found none, never `null` and never `[]`. The same list stays inside `error.message` for humans — agents read the array instead of splitting that sentence
- `doctor` reports the TLS provider and its posture token, so an operator auditing a Rust-native binary learns from the binary that `ring` builds C
- No product environment variable is read anywhere, tests included: live tests are gated by `#[ignore]` alone and run with `cargo test -- --ignored`

## Release 1.2.0 agent surface (Camada Y)
- Method missing `#method.X` → `ok=false` / `not_found` (exit 66); never parent-page false success
- Successful method fetch sets `data.extraction` to `method` only; agents MUST reject missing/`item_page`
- `--suggest` on method 404 ranks method leaves from the parent type HTML
- Error envelopes include top-level `command` and `duration_ms` (parity with success)
- Budget flags above hard max fail closed with exit 65 (no silent clamp)
- Body over configured `--max-body-bytes` (within hard max) is `error.kind=budget`, exit 74, `retryable=false`
- Method 404 `source_url` keeps the first probe kind (`struct`), not the last
- Dry-run documents `validation=url_shape_only` and parent kind probes
- Offline schemas: 19 wire names matching `schema --cmd all` at that release (cache/config aliases included; `agent-surface` arrived in 1.3.0)
- Skills EN/PT MUST reject method success when `extraction` is not `method`

## Release surface retained from 1.1.x
- `--match exact|prefix|substring` on search-in-crate (default prefix)
- `--page-token` on search-crates without positional query when the token carries the full query
- `--page-token` success and dry-run echo `query`/`page`/`per_page`/`sort` from the **effective URL**
- `--suggest` ranks exact → prefix → substring → edit-distance
- `doctor` top-level `ok` mirrors `data.ok` (exit 78 when unhealthy)
- Explicit `--timeout 0` / `--connect-timeout 0` fail-closed with exit 65
- `item_path` accepts hyphens and normalizes to underscores (rustc paths)
- Markdown scrub removes rustdoc chrome (`§`, "Copy item path")
- `doctor --online` for DNS probes to crates.io and docs.rs
- `data.cache_hit` on network payloads (local disk cache only)
- Canonical wire field `crate_name`
- `item_name` on get-item; associated methods resolve to `#method.name`
- `resolved_version` for concrete SemVer or stdlib channel `stable`
- Ranked hit `score` on search-in-crate
- Product knobs: CLI flags + XDG config.toml only (no product `DOCSRS_CLI_*` env)
- Completions emit raw shell scripts unless `--json` is explicit
- Human pre-release smoke: `scripts/smoke-live.sh` (not CI)

## Payload Reduction
- Eight global flags cut the JSON envelope before it is written, so no jq stage is needed
- `--select KEYS` projects dotted keys (alias `--fields`); when the payload holds a results array it projects the ELEMENTS
- Missing keys are skipped, never emitted as null
- `--filter EXPR` keeps elements matching `key=value`, `key!=value`, `key~substring`; `==` is a synonym of `=`
- Repeat `--filter` to conjoin with AND; a malformed expression fails closed with exit 65, never an empty set
- `--sort-by KEY` sorts ascending and stable; elements without the key go last
- `--dedupe-by KEY` drops later elements repeating the value; elements without the key are kept
- `--max-items N` bounds the EMISSION, never the query; `search-in-crate --limit` bounds the query
- `--count-only` replaces the payload with `{"count": N}`, counted after filter, dedupe-by and max-items
- `--truncate-content N` shortens every string above N characters, counting characters and never splitting UTF-8
- `--max-output-bytes N` caps the emitted payload; hard max 2097152 (2 MiB), above which it fails closed with exit 65
- Fixed order: filter, sort-by, dedupe-by, max-items, select, count-only, truncate-content, max-output-bytes
- Read `agent_surface` for `input_count`, `output_count`, `limited`, `content_truncated`, `output_truncated`
- `limited` separates "the set was small" from "the set was cut": only then does raising `--max-items` return more

## Command Surface
- Data: `search-crates`, `readme`, `get-item`, `search-in-crate`
- Discovery: `version`, `doctor`, `commands`, `schema`, `completions`
- Storage: `cache path`, `cache stats`, `cache clear`
- Configuration: `config path`, `config show`, `config init`
- Eleven top-level commands, seventeen invocable paths counting subcommands
